summary: Allows teachers to update or assign roll numbers to students within their specific class.
steps: Navigate to the section for 'Update Roll Number' (exact path may vary, often found under student management).
A list of students for the selected class will be displayed.
Click on 'Edit Roll Number' (or a similar option) to make the fields editable.
Enter or modify the roll numbers for the students as required.
Save the changes to update the roll numbers.
business_rules: Teachers are typically responsible for assigning and updating roll numbers for students within their assigned classes.
Roll numbers are distinct from admission numbers and must be assigned separately.
important_notes: This feature is essential for maintaining accurate class rosters and student identification within a class.
Ensure that roll numbers are unique within a class.
